events.form.refused.description: Before the button of an event's form, when the server refused it as a whole: kind is not_eligible, voice_unavailable (voice chat off or the organizer may not host rooms), rate_limited (10 events an hour), not_organizer, organizer_only (the visibility), closed (cancelled), not_found, scheduled (a date confirmed meanwhile), or other (the server could not be reached or failed).

events.manage.description: The name of the menu at the top of an event's page, for its organizer and co-organizers: changing it, its invitations, its co-organizers, cancelling it.

events.invitations.description: The title of the screen of an event's invitations, the heading and name of their list, and the item of the event's menu that leads to it.

events.coorganizers.description: The title of the screen of an event's co-organizers, and the item of the event's menu that leads to it, for its organizer.

events.cancel_menu.description: An item of an event's menu, for its organizer: cancels the event, asked first.

events.cancel.title.description: The question of the dialog before the organizer cancels an event.

events.cancel.text.defaultMessage: Todos que responderam são avisados, e ninguém mais pode responder. O evento continua neste servidor, marcado como cancelado. Isso não pode ser desfeito.
events.cancel.text.description: What follows cancelling an event, in its dialog.

events.cancel.note.description: The label of the note shown with an event's cancellation, in the dialog that cancels it.

events.cancel.note_hint.defaultMessage: Até {max} caracteres, mostrados na página do evento.
events.cancel.note_hint.description: Under the label of the note of an event's cancellation: max is how long it may be (500).

events.cancel.note_rule.description: Under the note of an event's cancellation, when it is too long: max is how long it may be (500).

events.cancel.keep.description: The button that closes the dialog of an event's cancellation without cancelling it, and the dialog's close.

events.cancel.confirm.description: The button that confirms cancelling an event.

events.cancel.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível cancelar o evento. Tente novamente.
events.cancel.failed.description: In the dialog that cancels an event, when the cancellation did not finish.

events.cancel.done.description: Said on an event's page once its organizer cancelled it.

events.cancel.closed.description: Said on an event's page when its organizer pressed Cancel the event and the server said it was cancelled already (from another device, or by a moderator); the page then shows it cancelled.

events.approval.menu.description: The name of the menu an organizer opens on an attendee of an event: name is the attendee's.

events.approval.op.description: An item of the menu an organizer opens on an attendee going or maybe: approved is yes (approves them) or other (takes the approval back).

events.approval.about.defaultMessage: A pessoa passa a ver os locais presenciais e online.
events.approval.about.description: Under Approve in an attendee's menu: what the approval changes for them.

events.approval.approved.description: Beside an attendee of an event, for its organizers, once an organizer approved them.

events.approval.done.defaultMessage: {approved, select, yes {Você aprovou {name}.} other {{name} não está mais aprovado.}}
events.approval.done.description: Said on an event's page once an organizer approved an attendee (approved yes) or took the approval back (other): name is the attendee's.

events.approval.failed.defaultMessage: {cause, select, not_attending {{name} não responde mais vou nem talvez, então não há nada a aprovar.} other {{approved, select, yes {Aprovar {name}} other {Remover a aprovação de {name}}} não foi concluído. Tente novamente.}}
events.approval.failed.description: Said on an event's page when an approval was refused or did not finish: cause is not_attending (the attendee changed their answer) or other; approved is yes (approving) or other (removing the approval); name is the attendee's.

events.approval.waiting.description: Beside an attendee going or maybe whom no organizer approved yet, for the event's organizers, before Approve.

events.approval.approve.description: The name of the Approve button beside an attendee waiting for approval, for assistive technology: name is the attendee's. It starts with the words the button shows (events.approval.op: Approve).

events.poll.actions.description: The head of the column of each date's actions in an event's date poll, for its organizers, for assistive technology.

events.poll.menu.description: The name of the menu at the end of a candidate date's row, for an event's organizers: date is the candidate's date and time.

events.poll.op.defaultMessage: {op, select, confirm {Confirmar esta data…} other {Retirar esta data…}}
events.poll.op.description: An item of a candidate date's menu, for an event's organizers: op is confirm (fixes the event's date to it and closes the poll, asked first) or other (withdraw: takes it out of the poll, asked first).

events.poll.last.defaultMessage: Uma enquete mantém pelo menos uma data.
events.poll.last.description: Under Withdraw this date in a candidate date's menu, when it is the poll's only date.

events.poll.ask_title.description: The question of the dialog before an organizer confirms a candidate date (op confirm) or withdraws it (other): date is the candidate's date and time.

events.poll.ask_text.defaultMessage: {op, select, confirm {A enquete se encerra, e todos que responderam ou foram convidados são avisados da data. Isso não pode ser desfeito.} other {As respostas dela também são removidas. Isso não pode ser desfeito.}}
events.poll.ask_text.description: What follows confirming a candidate date (op confirm) or withdrawing it (other), in its dialog.

events.poll.ask_cancel.defaultMessage: {op, select, confirm {Continuar a enquete} other {Manter a data}}
events.poll.ask_cancel.description: The button that closes the dialog of confirming (op confirm) or withdrawing (other) a candidate date without doing it.

events.poll.ask_confirm.description: The button that confirms a candidate date (op confirm) or withdraws it (other).

events.poll.done.defaultMessage: {op, select, confirm {O evento agora é em {date}.} other {Você retirou {date}.}}
events.poll.done.description: Said on an event's page once an organizer confirmed a candidate date (op confirm) or withdrew it (other): date is its date and time.

events.poll.act_failed.defaultMessage: {cause, select, last {{date} é a única data da enquete, então ela fica. Adicione outra data para retirá-la.} scheduled {A data foi confirmada nesse meio-tempo, então a enquete está encerrada.} started {{date} já começou, então não pode mais ser confirmada. Confirme uma data posterior ou adicione uma.} closed {O evento foi cancelado.} other {{op, select, confirm {Confirmar {date}} other {Retirar {date}}} não foi concluído. Tente novamente.}}
events.poll.act_failed.description: Said on an event's page when confirming or withdrawing a candidate date was refused or did not finish: cause is last (its only date), scheduled (a date confirmed meanwhile), started (the date is past), closed (cancelled) or other; op is confirm or other (withdraw); date is the candidate's.

events.poll.add_heading.description: The heading of the part under an event's date poll, for its organizers, that adds a candidate date; also its name.

events.poll.add.description: The button that adds the candidate date its fields hold to an event's poll.

events.poll.added.description: Said on an event's page once an organizer added a candidate date: date is its date and time.

events.poll.add_refused.defaultMessage: {cause, select, invalid {A data não foi adicionada: uma enquete tem até 20 datas diferentes, cada uma depois de agora.} scheduled {A data não foi adicionada: a data foi confirmada, e a enquete está encerrada.} closed {A data não foi adicionada: o evento foi cancelado.} other {Não foi possível adicionar a data. Tente novamente.}}
events.poll.add_refused.description: Under the part that adds a candidate date to an event's poll, when the server refused it: cause is invalid (20 dates already, the same date twice, a date out of the limits), scheduled, closed, or other.

events.poll.full.defaultMessage: Uma enquete tem até {count} datas. Retire uma para adicionar outra.
events.poll.full.description: In place of the part that adds a candidate date, when the poll has as many as it can: count is that number (20).

events.room_unavailable_organizer.defaultMessage: {reason, select, disabled {Não foi possível abrir: o chat de voz está desativado neste servidor. O evento continua.} not_eligible {Não foi possível abrir: você não pode ser anfitrião de salas de chat de voz neste servidor. O evento continua.} too_many_rooms {Não foi possível abrir: já havia tantas salas abertas quanto este servidor permite. O evento continua.} other {Não foi possível abrir: você era anfitrião de outra sala. O evento continua.}}
events.room_unavailable_organizer.description: Under an event's voice chat room that could not open at the start, why, for its organizer in their own words: reason is disabled, not_eligible, too_many_rooms, or other (hosting_elsewhere).

events.people.search.description: The label of the field that finds people to invite to an event or to name its co-organizers.

events.people.search_hint.defaultMessage: Só pessoas deste servidor podem ser escolhidas.
events.people.search_hint.description: Under the label of the field that finds people to invite to an event or name co-organizers.

events.people.clear.description: The button that empties the field that finds people for an event.

events.people.searching.description: In place of the people found for an event while the search runs.

events.people.search_failed.defaultMessage: A busca não foi concluída. Tente novamente.
events.people.search_failed.description: In place of the people found for an event when the search failed.

events.people.none_found.description: In place of the people found for an event when the search found none.

events.people.found.description: The name of the list of people found to invite to an event or name co-organizers, for assistive technology.

events.people.organizer.description: In place of the button beside an account found that organizes the event.

events.people.canceled.defaultMessage: Este evento foi cancelado, então ninguém pode ser convidado nem nomeado coorganizador.
events.people.canceled.description: In place of an event's invitations or co-organizers, when it was cancelled.

events.people.menu.description: The name of the menu of an account on an event's invitations or co-organizers: name is the account's.

events.invitations.loading.description: In place of the invitations of an event while they load.

events.invitations.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível carregar os convites.
events.invitations.failed.description: In place of the invitations of an event when they could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

events.invitations.none.defaultMessage: Ninguém foi convidado ainda. Quem é convidado sempre vê o evento.
events.invitations.none.description: In place of the invitations of an event while there are none.

events.invitations.revoke.description: The last item of the menu of an invited account on an event's invitations, apart: revokes the invitation, asked first.

events.invitations.revoked.description: Said on an event's invitations once one was revoked: name is the account's.

events.invitations.revoke_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível revogar o convite de {name}. Tente novamente.
events.invitations.revoke_failed.description: Said on an event's invitations when a revocation did not finish: name is the account's.

events.invitations.organizers_only.defaultMessage: Só o organizador do evento, {organizer}, e os coorganizadores podem convidar pessoas para ele.
events.invitations.organizers_only.description: In place of an event's invitations, for a reader who neither organizes nor co-organizes it: organizer is the organizer's name.

events.invitations.organizers_only.unava.defaultMessage: Só o organizador do evento e os coorganizadores podem convidar pessoas para ele.
events.invitations.organizers_only.unava.description: In place of an event's invitations, for a reader who neither organizes nor co-organizes it, when the organizer is an account the reader may not see (suspended, deactivated, hidden by the moderators, or blocking the reader); events.invitations.organizers_only otherwise.

events.invitations.list.description: The heading of the list of the people invited to an event, on its invitations' screen, and the list's name.

events.invitations.revoke_title.description: The question of the dialog before an organizer revokes an invitation to an event: name is the account's.

events.invitations.revoke_text.defaultMessage: Uma pessoa só pode ser convidada uma vez para um evento, então {name} não poderá ser convidado de novo. Isso não pode ser desfeito.
events.invitations.revoke_text.description: What follows revoking an invitation to an event, in its dialog: name is the account's.

events.invitations.revoke_confirm.description: The button that confirms revoking an invitation to an event.

events.invitations.revoke_keep.description: The button that closes the dialog of revoking an invitation without revoking it, and the dialog's close.

events.invite.heading.description: The heading of the part of an event's invitations that finds people and invites them.

events.invite.invite.description: The button beside an account found that invites it to the event.

events.invite.invited.description: In place of Invite beside an account found that is invited to the event already.

events.invite.done.description: Said on an event's invitations after an invitation: name is the account's.

events.invite.refused.defaultMessage: {kind, select, already_invited {{name} já foi convidado para este evento antes. Uma pessoa só pode ser convidada uma vez para um evento.} invalid_invitee {{name} não pode ser convidado para este evento.} rate_limited {Este evento enviou {count} convites na última hora, o máximo que pode. Tente novamente mais tarde.} other {Não foi possível convidar {name}. Tente novamente.}}
events.invite.refused.description: Said on an event's invitations when an invitation was refused: kind is already_invited (once per event, also after a revocation), invalid_invitee (a block between them and an organizer, an organizer, not an active local account), rate_limited (count, 100, an hour), or other; name is the account's.

events.coorganizers.count.description: The heading of an event's co-organizers on their screen: count is how many, max the most an event has (3).

events.coorganizers.none.defaultMessage: Ainda não há coorganizadores. Eles alteram o evento, convidam pessoas e aprovam participantes com você.
events.coorganizers.none.description: In place of an event's co-organizers while there are none.

events.coorganizers.remove.description: The last item of the menu of a co-organizer on an event's co-organizers, apart: removes them as co-organizer, asked first.

events.coorganizers.removed.description: Said on an event's co-organizers once one was removed: name is the account's.

events.coorganizers.remove_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível remover {name}. Tente novamente.
events.coorganizers.remove_failed.description: Said on an event's co-organizers when a removal did not finish: name is the account's.

events.coorganizers.heading.description: The heading of the part of an event's co-organizers that finds people and names them.

events.coorganizers.name.description: The button beside an account found that names it a co-organizer of the event.

events.coorganizers.named.description: In place of the button beside an account found that co-organizes the event already.

events.coorganizers.full.defaultMessage: Um evento tem até {count} coorganizadores. Remova um para nomear outro.
events.coorganizers.full.description: In place of the search of an event's co-organizers, when it has as many as it can: count is that number (3).

events.coorganizers.done.description: Said on an event's co-organizers once one was named: name is the account's.

events.coorganizers.refused.defaultMessage: {kind, select, invalid_coorganizer {{name} não pode coorganizar este evento.} too_many_coorganizers {Um evento tem até {count} coorganizadores. Remova um primeiro.} other {Não foi possível nomear {name}. Tente novamente.}}
events.coorganizers.refused.description: Said on an event's co-organizers when naming one was refused: kind is invalid_coorganizer (a block between them and an organizer, the organizer, not an active local account), too_many_coorganizers (count, 3), or other; name is the account's.

events.coorganizers.organizer_only.defaultMessage: Só o organizador do evento, {organizer}, pode nomear os coorganizadores.
events.coorganizers.organizer_only.description: In place of an event's co-organizers, for a reader who is not its organizer: organizer is the organizer's name.

events.coorganizers.organizer_only.unava.defaultMessage: Só o organizador do evento pode nomear os coorganizadores.
events.coorganizers.organizer_only.unava.description: In place of an event's co-organizers, for a reader who is not its organizer, when the organizer is an account the reader may not see (suspended, deactivated, hidden by the moderators, or blocking the reader); events.coorganizers.organizer_only otherwise.

events.coorganizers.remove_title.description: The question of the dialog before the organizer removes a co-organizer of an event: name is theirs.

events.coorganizers.remove_text.defaultMessage: A pessoa não pode mais alterar o evento, convidar pessoas nem aprovar participantes. Você pode nomeá-la de novo depois.
events.coorganizers.remove_text.description: What follows removing a co-organizer of an event, in its dialog.

events.coorganizers.remove_confirm.description: The button that confirms removing a co-organizer of an event.

events.coorganizers.remove_keep.description: The button that closes the dialog of removing a co-organizer without removing them, and the dialog's close.
